/online-booking-software.title: Online Booking Software for Service Businesses | NextSlot
/online-booking-software.description: Online booking software for independent service businesses. Let clients book available services, collect deposits and manage appointments without relying on messages.

/business-management-software.description: Business management software for independent service businesses. Run bookings, payments, clients, availability, inventory and business performance from one system.
/business-management-software.h1: Run the business behind the booking.
